Side B of the
US Open 2027.

Side A is the match. Side B is everything around it: the records, the selectors and the room. The Vinyl Collectiv, Chicago's premier vinyl community, brings vinyl culture to adidas Tennis in New York.

Who we are

Where real music lovers meet.

Founded in Chicago in 2025 by Virginia Shipp, The Vinyl Collectiv puts collectors, vinyl DJs and newcomers in the same room. Our mission is simple: make vinyl culture accessible to the masses, one record at a time.

Signature seriesBARCAV: Bring A Record, Catch A Vibe. Guests bring a record, hop on open decks and share what they love.
ResidencyMonthly BARCAV nights at Marc Nolan, backed by Red Bull in 2026, plus our DJ on Deck residency spotlighting vinyl DJs.
NetworkChicago record stores, venues and a roster of vinyl DJs.

What we could do for adidas at the US Open

Three ways to put adidas Tennis on wax.

New York, late summer 2027. Each concept scales from a single night to the full fortnight, and each maps to a format we already run.

From our Oct 27 conversation: connect women's sports, music culture and women-owned businesses through live experiences, with New York and the US Open as the natural stage.
